maria: Heads-up — nightly CI flagged a performance regression on the paged-attention path when using prefetch + fused kernels. Profiling trace attached.

devin: Which commit/PR caused it? any obvious diffs?

maria: b3f2c9e (runtime: batching heuristics tweak). Reproducer in CI: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/22344

josh: I ran a quick local repro. Builder image bumped base toolchain (gcc13 -> gcc14) in the new container image. nvcc still CUDA 12.1 but libstdc++ ABI looks different; see link: registry.redwood/builder:2026-03-gcc14

ci-bot: [CI] build 22344 failed on linux-x86_64
```
/usr/bin/ld: /opt/flashkernels/libflash.a(flash_paged.o): undefined reference to `flash_attn::fused_attention(...)'
collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
```

andrea: Perf trace (crude):
```
before: p50=12.3 tok/s p95=28.9 tok/s
after:  p50=9.0  tok/s p95=21.1 tok/s  <-- batching heuristic + prefetch enabled
kv-cache hitrate: 0.87 -> 0.74
```

andrea: looks like prefetch increases KV cache churn on longer contexts; extra memcpy + different kernel ordering seems to evict more prefixes.

max: two things to try: (1) pin builder image to gcc13 in CI to confirm toolchain mismatch; (2) rebuild flash kernels with `-D_GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1` and explicit `-fvisibility=hidden` to avoid symbol ODR/visibility issues.

devin: repro command i used:
```
docker run --rm -it -v $(pwd):/src registry.redwood/builder:2026-03-gcc14 /bin/bash -c \"cd /src && make -j8 && ./bench/paged_fused --seq 4096 --batch 8\"
```

josh: after rebuilding kernels with the ABI define + nvcc flags, link error went away locally and p50 recovered to ~11.8 tok/s. Not fully back to baseline though.

maria: open PR to pin CI to gcc13 while we validate patch? we should also add a perf unit test for KV cache hitrate regression.

devin: +1. I'll open a PR that pins the image, and another to add a micro-benchmark asserting kv hitrate >= 0.8 for our standard workload.

ci-bot: Re-run queued: https://ci.redwood.internal/build/22346

andrea: thanks — assigning to @devin and @josh to follow up. If we still see variance after toolchain pin, we should bisect batching heuristic change in b3f2c9e.

max: FYI I added a short note to the runbook about toolchain-induced kernel ABI issues and how to reproduce locally.

maria: great. I'll drop the profiling traces in the jira ticket RW-1724.
